notes.content:

Crash Reports


 Fixed crashes on game startup before the menu appears.
 Added 3rd party software that makes the game work.
 Added required DLL files.
 Minor fixes have been applied to the menu page.
 Performance improvements and optimization.


NEW MODELS ADDED


 New models have been brought to the Lanterns, Lighters and Keychains you use.
 Their resolution has been increased and harmonized.
